name: Marching Cubes Seam In-Place Reading
definition: A technique to optimize Marching Cubes seam meshing by having seam jobs read neighbor voxel data directly from participant snapshots instead of copying them into a synthetic request structure, reducing memory bandwidth and copy overhead.
summary: Marching Cubes Seam In-Place Reading is a CPU optimization that eliminates memory bandwidth overhead by reading neighbor voxel data directly from existing snapshots via pointers instead of copying them.
